author: Deadscopez
body:
Minecraft Name: Deadscopez
Reason For Ban: Kill-Aura
Reason why i should be unbanned: I dont know what a kill-aura is? I was not doing anything wrong, my friend coreyrulz and i play this server all the time and we Dont use cheats or anything like that, I was participating in a conversation and then I finally joined the game and got alot of kills in a row, Im not used to multiple Killstreaks, but most of the kills were knocking people off, and i got Banned from Cammy_G for Kill-Aura, which i dont know what that means. I would appreciate An unban so i can enjoy this awesome server again!
